Amber Chamber

Villa in Si Sunthon
HomeNew ProjectsAmber Chamber

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Amber Chamber is a small hillside collection of private-pool villas in the Bang Jo area of Si Sunthon, Thalang, in northwest Phuket. The project comprises 3 and 4-bedroom homes of roughly 428 to 620 sqm built-up across the Essence, Serenity and Bliss designs. Listings describe it as under construction, with shared co-working, fitness and pet areas plus round-the-clock security. Unit counts, prices and handover timing differ between marketing sources.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Amber Chamber?

Amber Chamber is a pool villa project in Si Sunthon, Phuket, developed by 2 Thanwa Property Co., Ltd..

What is the starting price of Amber Chamber?

Agent advertised price is ฿35,100,000, last checked 2026-11-14. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at Amber Chamber?

Sources list leasehold ownership. Always confirm the exact title and conditions with a Thai lawyer before buying; this is general information, not legal advice.

When will Amber Chamber be ready?

Current status: under construction. Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
